text:
By Data Skrive ,
2 hours ago
The Milwaukee Brewers will be on the road, beginning a three-game series against the Houston Astros on Friday, May 29 at 8:10 p.m. ET.
Astros vs. Brewers Series Info Brewers @ Astros Time: Friday, May 29 at 8:10 p.m. ET Astros Starting Pitcher: Kai-Wei Teng Brewers Starting Pitcher: Coleman Crow TV Channel : SCHN and Brewers.TV Livestream: Fubo Brewers @ Astros Time: Saturday, May 30 at 4:10 p.m. ET Astros Starting Pitcher: Peter Lambert Brewers Starting Pitcher: Brandon Sproat TV Channel : SCHN and Brewers.TV Livestream: Fubo Brewers @ Astros Time: Sunday, May 31 at 2:10 p.m. ET Astros Starting Pitcher: Tatsuya Imai Brewers Starting Pitcher: Jacob Misiorowski TV Channel : SCHN and Brewers.TV Livestream: Fubo How to Bet on Astros vs. Brewers Games Astros vs. Brewers Betting Insights The Astros have won five of the 16 games they were listed as the moneyline favorite this season (31.2%). Houston has won 19, or 47.5%, of the 40 games it has played as the underdog this season. The Brewers have won 65.6% of the games this season when they were favored on the moneyline (21-11). This season, Milwaukee has been the underdog 16 times and won nine, or 56.2%, of those games.
